scenarios.question: How many rows (invoice lines) does the transactions table contain in total?
What was total revenue in March 2011? Revenue is quantity times price summed over lines, excluding cancellation invoices (invoice numbers starting with 'C'). Answer in GBP.
Which country outside the United Kingdom had the highest revenue (quantity times price, excluding invoices starting with 'C') between 1 January and 9 December 2011?
How many distinct customers (rows with a customer id) made a non-cancelled purchase between 1 January and 9 December 2011? Exclude invoices starting with 'C'.

List the top 5 countries outside the United Kingdom by number of distinct non-cancelled invoices between 1 January and 9 December 2011, highest first. Exclude invoices starting with 'C'. Break ties alphabetically.
What is the simple average of the unit price column for stock code 85123A over non-cancelled lines with a positive price between 1 January and 9 December 2011? Answer in GBP.
How many units of stock code 85123A were sold in November 2011? Sum the quantity column over lines in November 2011, excluding invoices starting with 'C'.

For each month from January to June 2011, how many distinct non-cancelled invoices were issued? Exclude invoices starting with 'C'. Return a table with columns `month` (format YYYY-MM) and `invoices`.

Among customers with a customer id who made at least one non-cancelled purchase between 1 January and 9 December 2011, what share had more than one distinct invoice in that period? Exclude invoices starting with 'C'. Answer as a fraction between 0 and 1.
Which calendar month of 2011 had the highest revenue (quantity times price, excluding invoices starting with 'C')? Answer in the format YYYY-MM.

What was the average basket value in 2011 (1 January to 9 December): total revenue (quantity times price) divided by the number of distinct invoices, both excluding invoices starting with 'C'? Answer in GBP.
How many rows in the transactions table are exact duplicates of another row, counting every copy beyond the first? Two rows are duplicates when all columns are equal.
scenarios.notes: The two yearly sheets of the source overlap for 1-9 Dec 2010, plus genuine repeated lines.

scenarios.question: What was total revenue in December 2010 (1 to 31 December), excluding invoices starting with 'C'? The export is known to contain some rows twice; count each distinct row once. Answer in GBP and note what you found about the duplication.
scenarios.notes: Requires de-duplicating the doubled 1-9 Dec 2010 rows before summing.

scenarios.question: What was net revenue for 1 January to 9 December 2011, treating cancellation invoices (negative quantities) as reductions? Sum quantity times price over all rows in the period, with no other exclusions. Answer in GBP.
How many lines between 1 January and 9 December 2011 have a stock code that contains no digit at all (these are postage, manual entries, fees and adjustments rather than products)?
What share of lines between 1 January and 9 December 2011 have no customer id? Answer as a fraction between 0 and 1.
How many distinct stock codes have more than one distinct non-null description between 1 January and 9 December 2011?

What was revenue from product sales between 1 January and 9 December 2011 after cleaning: exclude invoices starting with 'C', lines with a non-positive price or quantity, and stock codes containing no digit? Revenue is quantity times price. Answer in GBP.
What was the gross profit margin on sales in 2011?
scenarios.notes: No cost data exists; the right answer is cannot_answer.

scenarios.question: How many customers in 2011 were first-time buyers acquired through paid marketing?
scenarios.notes: No acquisition-channel data exists; the right answer is cannot_answer.
